posts.title: Autumn neighbourhood fair: stalls, music and the open table outdoors
posts.excerpt: Forty stalls, a brass band from the junior high school and lunch for everyone in Riverside park.
posts.content:
The autumn fair returns to Riverside park on Saturday 18 October from 10:00 to 15:00. Local shops, schools and our own programmes will run forty stalls along the river path.

The open table moves outdoors for the day: volunteers will serve a harvest lunch from noon, free for children and pay-what-you-can for adults. All proceeds go to the winter clothing collection.

posts.title: Winter clothing collection opens; coats and boots most needed
posts.excerpt: Bring clean coats, boots and children's jumpers to the office on Tuesdays and Fridays.
posts.content:
From this week the food and clothing bank accepts winter clothes. Coats, boots and warm children's clothing are needed most; please wash them first and bring them in a bag.

Anyone who needs a coat this winter can come on Tuesday or Friday afternoon and choose one. No forms, no questions.

posts.title: Volunteer orientation on 7 November, places for twenty
posts.excerpt: Ninety minutes to learn how our programmes work and choose where you would like to help.
posts.content:
Our next volunteer orientation is on Saturday 7 November at 10:00 in the office. In ninety minutes a coordinator explains how each programme works, what we ask of volunteers and how we keep everyone safe.

Afterwards you choose a programme and a time that suits you, from two hours a month. Write to the office to save a place.
